title: Onye Nche n'akụkụ Osimiri
intro: N'ala ebe iwu onye ọchịchị aka ike wetara ọtụtụ ebe obibi mwute, mkpụrụ obi natara ozi nke na-emegide egwu niile. Ha ji obi jupụtara na ntụkwasị obi malite ime ihe ga-agbanwe ụzọ mba. Ka mmiri na-ebu ibu dị oké ọnụ ahịa, olileanya na-agwakọta na iyi mmiri.
clues: Ebi m n'oge mmegbu na egwu.
M nwetara mmụọ nsọ Chineke nke nyere m obi ike.
E nyere m iwu ka m ghara ịtụ egwu ma ọ bụ iru újú.
Etinyere m nwa m n'ime igbe wee tinye ya n'elu mmiri.
Ezinụlọ onye ọchịchị ahụ chọtara nwa m, mana nwa m nke ọzọ sochiri ya.
E ji nwayọọ nwayọọ nabata nwa m ka m nye ya ara, dịka Allah kwere nkwa.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ịbụ onye mmụọ nsọ ịtụba nwatakịrị n'ime osimiri
Ịbụ onye a na-ama aka ka ọ lụọ ọgụ anwansi
Ịgafe oke osimiri nke kewara ekewa
trial.answer: Ịbụ onye mmụọ nsọ ịtụba nwatakịrị n'ime osimiri

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E weghachiri nwatakịrị ahụ n'ụlọ nọọsụ n'enweghị nsogbu
Nwatakịrị ahụ furu efu ruo mgbe ebighị ebi
E bugara nwatakịrị ahụ n'ala dị anya
Nwatakịrị ahụ ghọrọ onye ọchịchị ozugbo
Otu onye ahịa bara ọgaranya kuchiri nwa ahụ
outcome.answer: E weghachiri nwatakịrị ahụ n'ụlọ nọọsụ n'enweghị nsogbu

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
